commands.name: Run reviewed owned interface workflow
effects: Open the explicitly reviewed, network-disabled owned simulation HTML and execute its fixed steps

limitations: Owned simulation only; not eligible for real hardware activation

Independent Node/browser runtime inventory is not an installer, sandbox or physical qualification
